description: Per-filter latency derived from trace spans. Tempo's metrics-generator turns every span into RED metrics; praxis emits one span per filter per phase, so span_name is the breakdown key. This answers 'which filter costs what', which a trace waterfall can only show one request at a time.

panels.description: P99 latency per filter span, across all requests in the window. The slowest filters sit at the top of the legend. SAMPLED: derived from sampled traces. Percentiles are unbiased under random sampling; volume is not -- read counts from Prometheus instead.

defaults.noValue: No span metrics yet - see the dashboard description

panels.title: P99 Latency by Filter Span

panels.description: Median latency per filter span. Compare against the P99 panel: a filter with a low median and a high P99 is bursty rather than uniformly slow. SAMPLED: derived from sampled traces. Percentiles are unbiased under random sampling; volume is not -- read counts from Prometheus instead.
panels.title: P50 Latency by Filter Span

panels.description: Latency quantile comes from SAMPLED span metrics; the request rate comes from praxis_http_requests_total, a Prometheus counter covering 100% of requests. Using the span-derived call rate here would under-report by exactly the sampling factor.
panels.title: Weighted Filter Cost (sampled P99 x true request rate)

panels.description: How often each span is produced. Request-phase filters run once per request; response_body-phase filters may not run at all for some responses. SAMPLED: derived from sampled traces. Percentiles are unbiased under random sampling; volume is not -- read counts from Prometheus instead.
panels.title: Span Rate by Filter

panels.description: End-to-end request span (the trace root), for scale against the per-filter panels above. SAMPLED: derived from sampled traces. Percentiles are unbiased under random sampling; volume is not -- read counts from Prometheus instead.
panels.title: End-to-End Request Latency (from spans)

panels.description: Error rate per span, from the span status recorded on each filter. SAMPLED: derived from sampled traces. Percentiles are unbiased under random sampling; volume is not -- read counts from Prometheus instead.
panels.title: Span Errors
